paper_evaluation_matrix.title: Host-Schedule Launch Overhead
paper_evaluation_matrix.claim: PTO CUDA host-schedule should be compared against direct CUDA launches, CUDA Driver graph replay, and CUDA Graph replay on the same vector and tensor launch shapes.
paper_evaluation_matrix.promotion_gate: Promote when A100 and H200 captures include PTO host-schedule, direct runtime launch, direct driver launch, CUDA Graph replay, stream-concurrency sweeps, and selected vector/tensor shapes with p50/p90/p99, mean, stdev, throughput, and raw JSON artifacts for each launch family.

paper_evaluation_matrix.title: Persistent-Device Scheduler Overhead
paper_evaluation_matrix.claim: PTO CUDA persistent-device should expose device-side scheduler overhead and task-dispatch behavior because CUDA has no Ascend-style AICPU scheduler.
paper_evaluation_matrix.promotion_gate: Promote when PTO persistent-device, MPK, and VDCores all have comparable A100 or Hopper-class artifacts with scheduler traces, task counts, resource policy, correctness, latency distributions, and an explicit measurement scope separating diagnostic instrumentation from final baseline timing rows.

paper_evaluation_matrix.title: Tensor-Core Tile Baselines
paper_evaluation_matrix.claim: Tensor-core PTO work must be compared against vendor and generated-kernel baselines before making throughput claims.
paper_evaluation_matrix.promotion_gate: Promote when PTO, cuBLAS or cuBLASLt, CUTLASS or CuTe, Triton or torch.compile, and ThunderKittens rows use the same tensor shapes, hardware metadata, correctness checks, and raw artifacts.

evidence_policy_exceptions.title: ThunderKittens 12288-token dense PyTorch reference OOM policy
evidence_policy_exceptions.scope: Only the official ThunderKittens H100 MHA dense PyTorch reference rows at sequence length 12288 on H200.
evidence_policy_exceptions.decision: Accept the tensor-core tile claim without those dense PyTorch reference rows because every selected 6144-token dense reference cell passes in fresh processes, FA3 forward/backward comparator rows cover 12288, and the remaining dense reference rows exceed practical H200 memory capacity.
evidence_policy_exceptions.rationale: The excluded rows are reference-oracle capacity failures, not missing ThunderKittens, FA3, PTO, cuBLAS/CUTLASS, or Triton measurements. They cannot provide timing evidence and should be reported as infeasible reference cells rather than blocking the tensor-core comparison.
evidence_policy_exceptions.review_rule: Paper tables may include the 12288-token dense PyTorch reference cells only as OOM/not-applicable footnotes; do not impute performance or correctness numbers from them.

paper_evaluation_matrix.title: LLM Serving Paper Baselines
paper_evaluation_matrix.claim: Paper-level PTO CUDA claims require a shared serving workload against MPK, VDCores, vLLM, SGLang, and ThunderKittens-family baselines.
missing_evidence: PTO persistent-device full-serving, VDCores Qwen3-8B full serving after the current global-instruction correctness blocker, and ThunderKittens-family full serving rows are not yet imported for the shared Qwen3-8B serving policies.
paper_evaluation_matrix.promotion_gate: Promote only after all paper baselines run on the same model and decode policy, raw outputs are archived under tmp/, and viewer result records show explicit full-Qwen numerical correctness details plus latency/throughput statistics.
